question:
You are designing a **series resonant** $LCR$ circuit for $50\,\text{Hz}$ operation using a **fixed** capacitor $C=100\,\mu\text{F}$. The series resistance is fixed at $R=10\,\Omega$.

You must choose an inductor $L$ so that the circuit resonates at $50\,\text{Hz}$. The circuit will be driven by a $100\,\text{V}$ (rms) source.

**Design constraint:** the capacitor is rated at $250\,\text{V}$ (rms), so you must ensure $V_C\le 250\,\text{V}$ at resonance. You are allowed to add an additional **non-inductive** series resistor $R_s$ only if needed.

Determine the required inductance $L$ and the minimum additional series resistance $R_s$ needed to satisfy the capacitor rating.
